title: Call 5 — Human Assistance Escalation
description: Customer demands to speak with a human supervisor; bot initiates graceful escalation.

dialogue.speaker: Agent (Sarah)
dialogue.text: Hello! Thank you for calling ApexCare Health Insurance. My name is Sarah. Are you looking to explore coverage options for yourself or your family today?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Hello, I have a complicated claim dispute with my hospital.

dialogue.speaker: Agent (Sarah)
dialogue.text: I don't have verified policy details for that in our official guidelines. Let me make a note so our specialist can clarify that for you.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: I don't want to talk to an automated AI. I want to speak with a human supervisor right now please.

dialogue.speaker: Agent (Sarah)
dialogue.text: I completely understand. Let me transfer you directly to our Senior Underwriting Specialist right away. Please hold on a moment.
